data.design: Use the established Weedle body, large red nose and head horn. Proposed field motion emphasizes the nose checking a leaf, then the small defensive withdrawal that makes the horn visible. Its warm ordinary palette should remain distinct beside the pale-blue regional Wurmple.

description:
An ordinary Bug/Poison caterpillar in the Listening Wood’s grass. Its native species account distinguishes preferred leaves by smell; Poison Sting and String Shot are available from level 1. Its early evolution into Kakuna at level 7 differs from regional Wurmple’s fixed level-10 branch. Poison typing alone does not connect it to Koga, demon-defense practices or the poisoned refuge.

Proposed forest behavior: it runs its nose along a leaf edge before feeding, rejecting some leaves that neighboring Wurmple readily eat. That allows two small caterpillars to share a patch without being interchangeable palette variants. On a low branch it draws its head back and presents the horn when crowded. Reaching around it or leaving that leaf alone can avoid a sting; a careless approach need not summon a supernatural explanation. A companion’s sniff-and-select routine makes food preference visible without creating a compulsory feeding meter.

links.description: Proposed feeding scene: Weedle rejects some leaves by smell while nearby regional Wurmple continue feeding. Their overlapping habitat does not mean identical food preferences, defenses or evolution routes.
Authored forest and road encounter tables, including the pond-grass table on the road map.
